mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering a flight to quality that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 420000.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has fallen below 95.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a severe demand contraction, triggering a risk-off sentiment that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 < 15500 and HOUST < 850.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market contraction regime (HOUST < 900), consumer confidence and retail sales decline, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as demand weakness spreads to the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST is below 900.
